mapper.select: select id, uid, title, isdelete, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ai_chat_session where id = #{id} and uid = #{uid} and isdelete = '0'
select id, uid, title, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ai_chat_session where uid = #{uid} and isdelete = '0' order by update_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_chat_session (id, uid, title, isdelete, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{uid}, #{title}, '0', now(), now())
mapper.update: update ai_chat_session set isdelete = '1' where id = #{id} and uid = #{uid}
